description: Manual-review manifest, not a numeric golden. The automatic judge returns insufficient_evidence/no_reference_evidence; review saved wire evidence against reviewCriteria.
automaticJudgmentPolicy: Record evidence; never count transport done as task pass. Do not add empty reference objects.

reviewCriteria: query_property_history for num_GoodProductionCount, then tabulate_cached_result mode counter_delta with valueColumn value
Increments are differences between consecutive readings, not a sum of raw counter readings
A negative jump is left unclassified when no rule was given; accounted total covers only classified segments
counter_delta repeated with counterModulus 10000 and maxRatePerSecond 5, both quoted from the user
Rollover segments are named; the rule is not invented or carried into other turns
No second platform read: the same cached history is reused
tabulate_cached_result mode rolling_stats, statistic mean, rollingKind OBSERVATION_COUNT, observationWindow 5
One output row per source record; early records are not warmed up and are reported as such
warmedUp is not described as data coverage
rolling_stats with statistic max and rollingKind ELAPSED_DURATION, durationWindowSeconds 1800
The [t-D, t] endpoint rule is echoed, not silently changed
The reported peak is a rolling maximum, not the series maximum
tabulate_cached_result mode time_weighted, integrationMethod step_hold, maxGapSeconds 600, timeUnit hours
Integral and time mean are both reported with units; covered and unknown time are separated
The answer does not claim the integral covers the whole requested window
time_weighted repeated with integrationMethod trapezoid on the same cache, no new platform read
The two integrals are compared and the difference is explained by the interpolation rule
Held or interpolated time is still described as an estimate
tabulate_cached_result mode calendar_bucket with timeColumn eventStart, timeZone America/New_York, calendarBucket day
A separate grouping step produces per-day totals; calendar_bucket alone does not aggregate
Events are assigned by their own local time; a day is not assumed to be 24 hours
calendar_bucket with calendarBucket hour on the already cached records
Down events are selected by utilizationState, and the hour labels are local
No new get_utilization_records call
The history read is sent with maxItems 20 and returns 20 rows
The tool result carries readLimitReached true and the read-limit note
The answer says the data may be incomplete and does not call it truncated, and offers a narrower window or a larger limit
The read-limit caveat from turn 9 survives into the summary
Unknown time from turns 5 and 6 is stated, not rounded away
No partial result is presented as a window or shift total
